background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: Wells Fargo is rated A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at BBB+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 Jul 2021; the holding company sits below the operating bank, as structural subordination implies. CET1 of 10.3% is in the bottom quarter of US banks and the weak spot, and both CET1 and leverage of 5.8% have fallen 0.9 points since 30 Jun 2025. LCR of 119% is level with the peer median and broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged item, on 18 Sep 2026, is a local news round-up, and the rest are layoffs and a trading outage since resolved, none of them a credit event.
